name: ls-theme/phase-services
title: Phase Services
description: Renders the current lifecycle phase page's "Services in this phase" heading and service cards. Implements CodeRabbit's request-time rendering fix for patterns/sections/phase-services-in-phase.php: PHP phase-detection baked into a pattern's own content only re-evaluates while the pattern stays a live wp:pattern reference, and is lost if WordPress flattens it, so the phase-dependent selection and markup now live in this dynamic block's render.php instead, which runs at real request time regardless of how the surrounding pattern is stored.
